mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which historically correlates with increased wage pressures and reduced corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as markets react to the weakening economic activity.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 70% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 300,000 in a month signals strong labor market conditions, which historically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases by more than 300,000 and S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months signals a strengthening housing market, which boosts related industries and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases for 3 consecutive months and S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When Industrial Production (INDPRO) is declining and Real GDP (GDPC1) growth is below 1% quarter-over-quarter, the combination signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO is declining and GDPC1 QoQ < 1%, but S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances.
